title: KATSEYE Reveals ‘WILD’ EP Tracklist Alongside Special Message From Lara Raj About Bonus Song
summary: "I know that you guys have been asking and waiting for a song written and produced by one of us," Raj said.
contentText:
KATSEYE has unveiled the tracklist for its upcoming WILD EP, just two weeks shy of the project’s scheduled Aug. 14 release.

Related

Ed Sheeran Reveals KATSEYE’s ‘Gnarly’ Inspired Him to Reach Out & Write ‘Animal’

‘Alright, Let’s Get Wild’: Demi Moore Helps KATSEYE Unlock Their Inner ‘Animal’: Watch

The group’s forthcoming EP will include five standard tracks, opening with the Billboard Hot 100 hit “Pinky Up,” which peaked at No. 28. The newly released “Animal,” cowritten by tunesmith Ed Sheeran, then follows, along with unheard gems “Hootie Frutti,” “Bel Air” and “That Way,” and the Target-exclusive bonus song “Unloveu.”

In addition to KATSEYE revealing WILD ‘s song titles via Instagram on Thursday (July 30), member Lara Raj also had a special reveal to share with EYEKONS. “I’m so excited to announce WILD is going to include a special bonus song called ‘Unloveu’ that I wrote and produced with Amy Allen and Ross Golan,” she shared. “I know that you guys have been asking and waiting for a song written and produced by one of us, so I really, really hope that you love it.” Allen has penned hits for artists such as Sabrina Carpenter , Harry Styles and Justin Bieber , while Golan has collaborated with acts such as Selena Gomez , Ariana Grande and Maroon 5 , making the partnering an exciting addition to KATSEYE’s discography.

The upcoming project follows the group’s Beautiful Chaos EP, which debuted at No. 4 on the Billboard 200 last year, becoming KATSEYE’s first top 10 entry on the chart and its highest charting release to date.

The tracklist announcement comes as anticipation continues to build for WILD , which arives Aug. 14 via HYBE x Geffen Records. Check out KATSEYE’s tracklist reveal and Lara’s video message to fans below:
